not_a_validation: exploratory only; never pooled numerically with U01-U07/Q3 and never a formal validation

scope.reporting: results are reported per unit and per question; any six-unit summary is descriptive only and must keep the per-question values visible

analytic_units.rule: a local id is never used without its blind_unit_id

claude_audit.blinding: sides labelled REFERENCE / CANDIDATE; opaque unit labels; no model names, no Q3 results, no benchmark, no experimental condition, no provenance

HYBRID_CONFIRMED_MATCH: both repetitions give an accepted correspondence category
every cited quotation is literally verifiable in the unit
no quotation is from the moderator
decision_rules.HYBRID_UNRESOLVED: any disagreement, invalid evidence, LOW confidence or conceptually ambiguous case. Counted as neither a match nor a confirmed error.
decision_rules.HYBRID_CORROBORATED_NOVEL: both repetitions VALID_NOVEL_THEME, confidence not LOW, evidence valid

derived: one human theme -> several machine themes = possible fragmentation
one machine theme -> several human themes = possible fusion
granularity.reported_corroborated_only_when: both repetitions agree and evidence passes

evaluated_in_order.when: unresolved human themes > 40% of 18, OR the mean per-question lower-upper band width > 0.35 — the check cannot say anything
in at least 3 of the 4 questions the UPPER bound is still below the Q3 recall of 0.6818 — even the optimistic reading falls short
in every question the band [lower, upper] reaches or exceeds 0.6818, AND no unsupported/spurious theme is corroborated in >= 2 units

final_classification_rule.explicitly_not: The choice never depends on whether a single pooled average exceeds 0.6818. Per-question results, band width, unresolved share and recurrent unsupported themes all enter.
final_classification_rule.n_caveat: Per-question denominators are 6 (Q1), 4 (Q2), 4 (Q4), 4 (Q5). These are far too small for any inferential reading; a single theme moves a question by 0.17-0.25.
final_classification_rule.no_pass_fail: No PASS/FAIL is issued under any branch.

q3_reference_for_description_only.note: descriptive comparison only; never a test, never pooled

protections: no model, prompt or configuration is substituted
